dsh-MusicPlayer 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

dsh-MusicPlayer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cb547c13828da006e077.html
